◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your
📻 The old ones point at the horizon and don't speak. The System, for once, is quiet too. Then: the Herald. It heralds the apocalypse the way dawn heralds the day.
